Maya: Quick sync -> onboarding AcmeAI to AWS/GCP/Azure marketplaces. Need decisions on publisher account (third-party vs Redwood), KMS ownership, trial SKU mapping (5-seat, 14-day), and payout contact.
Jared: Legal prefers third-party publisher. If Acme keeps KMS we need a narrow MOI + addendum. I can draft.
Anika: Product: 14-day, 5-seat, token metering. If marketplaces don't support seat trials, we'll map it server-side and mark listing as "trial via vendor".
Samir: Eng checklist: AWS needs IAM ARN + KMS alias; GCP needs project id + key resource; Azure needs tenant id + managed identity. If they can't provide, we can host keys but that changes compliance.
Devon: Ops: Azure offer skeleton needs offerId early. Also need Acme billing contact for payout wiring.
Maya: Acme said they'd provide IAM/KMS and billing by Tue EOD. Action owners: Jared -> addendum, Anika -> listing copy/SKU map, Samir -> role templates, Devon -> Azure offer. Reconvene Tue 10am PT.
